resources.name: SubmitHub
resources.description: The original music submission platform. Send your tracks directly to bloggers, playlist curators, and influencers. Free submissions (slow response) or premium credits (~$1–$4 per submission) for guaranteed feedback within 72 hours.

resources.name: Groover
resources.description: Pitch your music to curators, media outlets, influencers, radio stations, and record labels. Pay-per-pitch model with a guaranteed response within 7 days. Strong European and international curator network.

resources.name: MusoSoup
resources.description: PR and promotion platform connecting independent musicians with music bloggers, playlisters, and podcasters. Automated campaign management with per-blog pricing and real-time tracking. Note: many curators charge for coverage (about £8–£12 each) on top of the one-time £42 campaign fee, though every paid offer also comes with a free option — budget accordingly.

resources.name: One Submit
resources.description: Submit to over 2,200 music curators across Spotify playlists, TikTok influencers, music blogs, YouTube channels, magazines, and online radio stations — all from a single submission form.
resources.cost: From $4 per submission ($6 per Spotify playlist)

resources.name: Genni (formerly Songfluencer)
resources.description: Creator marketing agency (formerly Songfluencer) that pairs your track with vetted TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creators. Its team can manage the entire campaign — creator selection, briefing, content approval, and reporting — or you can run campaigns yourself on its self-serve platform.
resources.cost: Managed campaigns by quote; self-serve from $500/mo

resources.name: SpaceLoud
resources.description: Self-serve marketplace where artists set their own budgets, browse influencer profiles, and manage campaigns directly. Good for artists who want hands-on control over creator selection and spending.

resources.name: Kolsquare
resources.description: Influencer marketing platform with a database of millions of KOL (Key Opinion Leader) profiles across major social platforms. Search by niche, audience demographics, engagement rate, and more.

resources.name: Playlist Push
resources.description: One of the most established playlist promotion platforms. Matches your music with independent Spotify playlist curators based on genre. Also offers TikTok influencer campaigns. Transparent feedback from every curator.

resources.name: SubmitLink
resources.description: Spotify playlist submission platform from the team behind artist.tools, with 900+ active vetted curators and bot screening of every playlist. A free campaign reaches two playlists per day; paid submissions cost $2–$5 per playlist, and you get account credit for any curator who doesn't respond within 7 days. Placement is not guaranteed.

resources.name: Soundplate
resources.description: Spotify playlist directory and submission tool. Browse hundreds of curator playlists by genre and submit your track directly to those that accept submissions. Submitting is free.

resources.name: Hypeddit
resources.description: Free music promotion tools including smart links, fan-gating pages, and a repost exchange network. Widely used in electronic and dance music but works across genres.
resources.cost: Free; paid plans from $9/mo billed yearly ($14 month-to-month)

resources.name: Indie Music Academy
resources.description: Music marketing education and promotion services for independent artists, including a TikTok trending-sound campaign alongside Spotify and YouTube promotion. Offers courses, coaching, and done-for-you promotion.

resources.name: Ditto Music Promotions
resources.description: Promotion arm of Ditto Music distribution. Offers 4-week Promo campaigns or Promo Plus package with 2 extra weeks of marketing plus paid social advertising. Promo costs $499 and Promo Plus $649 (one-time, US prices); both include playlist pitching, two guaranteed blog features, a press release and a social media plan.

resources.name: Feature.fm
resources.description: Smart links, pre-save pages, and marketing analytics for musicians. Create landing pages that route fans to their preferred streaming platform. Essential for tracking the results of influencer campaigns.
resources.cost: Free tier; paid plans from $8/mo ($7/mo billed yearly)

resources.name: Linkfire
resources.description: Industry-standard smart link platform used by major labels and indie artists alike. Create beautiful landing pages, track clicks by geography and platform, and integrate with ad platforms.
resources.cost: Free trial, then a limited free account; Pro $27/mo ($21/mo billed yearly)

resources.name: Social Blade
resources.description: Free analytics tool for checking any public social media account's follower growth, engagement trends, and estimated earnings. Essential for vetting influencers before you reach out — spot fake followers and declining accounts.

resources.name: HypeAuditor
resources.description: AI-powered influencer analytics and fraud detection platform. Analyzes audience quality, engagement authenticity, and demographics. Helps you avoid paying for influencers with fake or bot followers.
resources.cost: Free basic reports; plans from $299/mo billed annually

resources.name: Chartmetric
resources.description: Music industry analytics platform that tracks playlist placements, social media growth, and audience data across all platforms. See which playlists and influencers are driving streams for artists in your genre.
resources.cost: Free tier; paid plans from $40/mo billed yearly ($60 month-to-month)

resources.name: SpotOnTrack
resources.description: Music analytics tool (Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, Shazam, TikTok and more) that tracks your playlist placements, follower growth, and streaming trends over time. Useful for measuring the impact of influencer and playlist campaigns.
resources.cost: 14-day free trial, then €29.99/mo (2 months free if paid yearly)
highlights: Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer & Shazam data

resources.name: SoundCampaign
resources.description: Playlist pitching service that sends your track to vetted Spotify curators for written feedback, with TikTok and Instagram creator campaigns and Meta ads also available. You set the budget (from $80) and pay only for completed reviews; its Artist Protection Program credits back any review that doesn't happen. Says it has served 100,000+ artists and labels since 2018.
highlights: TikTok, Instagram and Meta ad campaigns

resources.name: TikTok for Artists
resources.description: Official TikTok platform for artists with music insights and analytics on songs, posts, and followers. Helps artists build careers, connect with fans, improve promotional efforts, and inform content creation on TikTok. Pre-Release tool lets fans pre-save upcoming albums and EPs to Spotify or Apple Music from TikTok. Free; requires a certified TikTok Artist Account. Note: TikTok's US app moved to a new US joint venture in January 2026 and remains available.
highlights: Requires a certified TikTok Artist Account

resources.name: Viberate
resources.description: Music analytics and discovery tool offering real-time playlist placement alerts and rank change notifications across Spotify, TikTok, Airplay, and YouTube. Features artist charts, performance benchmarking, and geographic listener maps. Lower-cost alternative to Chartmetric, with plans from $49/mo ($33/mo billed yearly).

resources.name: Sound.me
resources.description: Influencer campaign platform that connects artists with TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts creators who use your track in their content. Automated matching based on genre and creator audience; you pay only for approved posts.
